thread:
maria: Kestrel just confirmed they want +3 GPUs in Dedicated and to switch to quarterly billing starting next term. Procurement is blocking on two things: SOW addendum + KMS key management addendum. PO won't be raised until both are signed. Any objections to the bill cadence change? :thinking_face:

olivia: Sales OK with quarterly if finance signs off. Need Derek to run the adjusted quote and show uplift vs annual. Also note: customer wants a soft start aligned to onboarding (~2 weeks).

derek: On it. Quick Q — prepaid quarterly or Net30 invoicing each quarter?

maria: They prefer Net30 per quarter.

ben: Legal needs a concise SOW addendum to attach. Also confirm whether we have a customer-managed KMS addendum template for Dedicated/Private. If not, we need eng/infosec sign-off before sending.

maria: Draft addendum below — please review and edit as needed:

- Add 3x nvidia-a100 GPU units to Dedicated pool for account Kestrel (instance cap: 3)
- Billing: quarterly invoicing, Net30, prorated at time of activation for the initial quarter
- Services: onboarding support (8 hours) to be scheduled within 14 days of activation
- Term: addendum applies for the remainder of the existing 12-month commitment

ben: Good start. Legal edits: replace 'prorated' with 'prorated at time of activation', and add: 'Customer-managed KMS usage is subject to the KMS Addendum and engineering compatibility validation.' I'll append a paragraph and send to eng for a quick thumbs-up.

maria: Tagging @ben and @derek — once wording is locked can we route to Kestrel via e-sign? They prefer DocuSign.

docusign-bot: Docusign envelope created (draft): https://docusign.example/xxxxxxxxx — assigned to ben for review.

derek: Pricing calc: quarterly list price per GPU = $X; quarterly uplift vs annual commit = 10% -> net impact +$Y over 12 months. If Legal keeps term as 'remainder of commitment' pricing will be prorated for unused months. Approve to publish these numbers in the quote?

olivia: Approve. I'll update the quote PDF and include PO instructions (vendor code + remit). Customer procurement needs vendor_code: 98765 and remit: remit@redwood.example.

maria: Next actions: Ben finalize addendum in the doc, Derek finalize quote line item and attach to envelope, Olivia prep explicit PO instructions. I'll confirm Kestrel signers and onboarding window. ETA EOD tomorrow?

ben: I'll finish the addendum by noon tomorrow and ping eng for KMS check.

docusign-bot: Envelope sent to Kestrel signers at 1777000250. Status: sent — link: https://docusign.example/xxxxxxxxx/sent

olivia: I'll ping procurement contact to expect the envelope and to prepare the PO after signature.

maria: Thanks team :raised_hands: Posting final signed SOW addendum here once it's back.
